title: Google Launches Gemini 4 Argon for Trusted Cyber Defenders
description:
Google just released a powerful new AI model for cyber defense, but it’s restricted to a select few. We’re breaking down what this means for your security and the future of AI-driven protection.

What we covered:
• Google Launches Gemini 4 Argon for Trusted Cyber Defenders
• DeepMind Introduces SynthID Bio to Watermark Synthetic Proteins

Three distinct AI stories, with lively debate, useful discoveries and practical takeaways.

Alex, Jamie and Rufus tell you what changed in AI, who wins, and what you do next.
